title: Lot's Daughters and the Ancestors of Moab and Ammon
description: After the destruction of Sodom, Lot fled from Soar to the mountains with his two daughters and lived in a cave. Fearing they would have no descendants, the daughters got their father drunk on wine for two nights in a row and slept with him without his knowledge. The older daughter gave birth to Moab, the ancestor of the Moabites, and the younger gave birth to Ben-Ammi, the ancestor of the Ammonites.
